Source: advisor_pilot_20261113/brainstorm_20261116/predictive_brainstorm_20261121/SYNTHESIS_ADV_PREDICTIVE_BRAINSTORM_20261121.md and the data sheet of the Kv7 batch (adv098_agent_sheets_he_20261119).] [Dated 2026-11-21, IT, ADV-158: Qualification of 'overlap' (IT, ADV-158): the held juvenile-rat paper (Brown 2016, PMID 26865186; read at passage level by SCI, qualified by SCI's ADV-119 result, as written on the Kv7 sheet advisor_pilot_20261113/adv098_agent_sheets_he_20261119/BATCH2_Kv7_ezogabine_azetukalner_ICA069673_XE991_HE_20261119.md) gives single-dose pup total brain values of 330, 1296 and 2013 ng/ml at 5, 15 and 30 mg/kg (1.09, 4.27 and 6.64 microM on SCI's 1 ml per g assumption; the time point is not in the text read) and apoptosis after repeated dosing in 5 of 8 regions, with one-tailed a priori tests, no correction across regions, males only, the striatum not assessable, and repeated-dose exposure NOT measured (the authors infer it did not exceed the 30 mg/kg single-dose level). The Kv7 penalty stands for the reason the ADV-156 line gave first: no margin has been measured in juveniles.
